title.narrative: Analytics for Advancing the Financial Sustainability of the HIV/AIDS Response (AFS)

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): The cross bureau funding will provide technical assistance to understand and utilize resource alignment data to maximize transparency, accountability and value of all available resources. Lead costing activities, including activity-based costing and management (ABC/M), to better understand cost drivers and improve efficiency and effectiveness of resources. Facilitate the development of analytic tools to apply health and HIV financing data for planning and decision-making. Perform private sector landscaping and analytics to advance private sector engagement and financing. Apply multiple data streams--including financing, program, and macroeconomic data--to perform integrated analytics to inform the development of sustainability roadmaps. Assist in applying the methodologies developed and utilized under PEPFAR, e.g., resource alignment or ABC/M, to other health areas.
